checks: A delayed burst keeps the newest pose and latest world even when its last frame contains no world; replay and oversized snapshots are rejected.
Excess guest poses remain bounded to one pending state and cannot kick the host or lose the latest position.
Control-message floods still disconnect only the offending guest; strikes reset across separate rate windows.
Leaving a session clears its queued snapshot and timer; stale callbacks cannot revive the old room.
Slow channel negotiation leaves a fresh handshake window; silent negotiation and silent open channels still time out.
